title: Fixed moving columns across the freeze line after freezing a column with `manualColumnFreeze`, which now works like `fixedColumnsStart`, including the drop guideline being hidden under the frozen columns and the selection staying on the old column after a freeze or unfreeze from the menu. Added the `restoreColumnPosition` option of `manualColumnFreeze`, which moves an unfrozen column back to its data source position, and a `finalIndex` argument to the `beforeColumnUnfreeze` and `afterColumnUnfreeze` hooks.
